title: OverlayRequest
description: Which copy to change, and which paths to put into it as they are at a commit.

folder.description: A copy this mode made, relative to the project, such as .forge/copies/my-copy. Never a worktree.

commit.description: The commit the paths are taken from. A commit: a full or short hash, or a branch name. It has no .. and does not start with a dash.

items.description: A path relative to the copy, the same as relative to the repository's root. It has no .. and does not start with a dash.

paths.description: The paths to put into the copy.
